verses.text: For di return of di year, for di time wey kings dey go out to war, David send Joab and im servants with am and all Israel. Dem destroy di pikin dem of Ammon and besiege Rabbah, but David stay for Jerusalem.
For evening, David rise from im bed and waka for di roof of di king house. From di roof e see one woman dey bathe, and di woman dey very beautiful to look at.
David send go ask about di woman. Somebody talk say, “Dis no be Bathsheba, di pikin woman of Eliam, di wife of Uriah di Hittite?”
David send messengers and take di woman. Di woman come in to am, and e sleep with am, because di woman don purify from im uncleanness. Den di woman return to im house.
Di woman become pregnant, and e send tell David say, “I dey pregnant.”
David send word to Joab say, “Send Uriah di Hittite to me.” Joab send Uriah to David.
When Uriah come to am, David ask am how Joab dey, how di people dey, and how di war dey go.
David talk to Uriah say, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah go out of di king house, and di king send gift follow am.
But Uriah sleep for di door of di king house with all im oga servants, and e no go down to im house.
When dem tell David say, “Uriah no go down to im house,” David talk to Uriah say, “You no come from journey? Why you no go down to your house?”

Uriah talk to David say, “Di ark, Israel and Judah dey stay inside tents, and my oga Joab and di servants of my oga dey camp for di open field. Make I go enter my house to eat, to drink and to sleep with my wife? As you dey alive, and as your soul dey alive, I no go do dis thing.”
David talk to Uriah say, “Stay here today too, and tomorrow I go let you go.” So Uriah stay for Jerusalem dat day and di next day.
When David call am, e eat and drink before am, and David make am drunk. For evening, e go out to lie down on im bed with im oga servants, but e no go down to im house.
For morning, David write letter to Joab and send am by Uriah hand.
E write for di letter say, “Put Uriah for di front of di hottest battle, and withdraw from am, so that dem go strike am and e go die.”
When Joab dey besiege di city, e put Uriah for di place wia e know say brave men dey.
Di men of di city go out and fight with Joab. Some of di people fall, even of David servants, and Uriah di Hittite die too.
Den Joab send tell David everything about di war,
and e command di messenger say, “When you finish to tell di king everything about di war,
e go be say, if di king anger rise, and e talk to you say, ‘Why you go near di city so to fight? You no know say dem go shoot from di wall?

Who strike Abimelech di pikin of Jerubbesheth? One woman no throw upper millstone from di wall on am so tay e die for Thebez? Why you go near di wall so?’ den you go talk say, ‘Your servant Uriah di Hittite don die too.’”
So di messenger go, and come show David all wetin Joab send am for.
Di messenger talk to David say, “Di men overcome us, and come out to us for di field, but we push dem back reach di entrance of di gate.
Di shooters shoot your servants from di wall, and some of di king servants don die, and your servant Uriah di Hittite don die too.”

Den David talk to di messenger say, “Na so you go tell Joab, ‘Make dis thing no displease you, because di sword dey devour one person and another. Make your battle strong more against di city, and overthrow am.’ Encourage am.”
When Uriah wife hear say im husband Uriah don die, e mourn for im husband.
When di mourning pass, David send take am come im house, and e become im wife, and e born pikin man for am. But di thing wey David do displease di Lord.
Di Lord send Nathan to David. E come to am and talk to am say, “Two men dey for one city, one rich and di other poor.
Di rich man get plenty flocks and herds,

but di poor man no get anything except one small ewe lamb wey e buy and raise. E grow together with am and with im pikin dem. E dey eat im own food, drink from im own cup, and lie for im bosom, and e be like pikin woman to am.

One traveller come to di rich man, and e no gree take from im own flock and from im own herd to prepare for di traveller wey come to am, but e take di poor man lamb and prepare am for di man wey come to am.”
David anger burn hot against di man, and e talk to Nathan say, “As di Lord dey alive, di man wey do dis thing suppose die!
E must pay back di lamb four times, because e do dis thing and because e no get pity.”
Nathan talk to David say, “Na you be di man. Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk say, ‘I anoint you king over Israel, and I deliver you from di hand of Saul.
I give you your oga house and your oga wives into your bosom, and I give you di house of Israel and of Judah. If dat dey too small, I go don add plenty more things like dat to you.
Why you despise di word of di Lord to do wetin evil for im eyes? You strike Uriah di Hittite with sword, take im wife to be your wife, and kill am with di sword of di pikin dem of Ammon.
So now di sword no go ever leave your house, because you despise me and take di wife of Uriah di Hittite to be your wife.’

Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Look, I go raise up evil against you from your own house. I go take your wives before your eyes and give dem to your neighbour, and e go sleep with your wives for di sight of dis sun.
Because you do am for secret, but I go do dis thing before all Israel and before di sun.’”
David talk to Nathan say, “I don sin against di Lord.” Nathan talk to David say, “Di Lord don put away your sin too. You no go die.
But because by dis deed you don give big reason to di Lord enemies to blaspheme, di pikin wey dem born for you go surely die.”
Nathan go im house. Di Lord strike di pikin wey Uriah wife born for David, and e sick well well.
So David beg God for di pikin. David fast, go inside, and lie all night for di ground.
Di elders of im house stand beside am to raise am up from di ground, but e no gree, and e no eat bread with dem.

On di seventh day, di pikin die. David servants fear to tell am say di pikin don die, because dem talk say, “Look, while di pikin still dey alive, we speak to am and e no listen to our voice. How e go take trouble imself if we tell am say di pikin don die?”
But when David see say im servants dey whisper together, David understand say di pikin don die. David talk to im servants say, “Di pikin don die?” Dem talk say, “E don die.”

Den David rise from di ground, wash, anoint imself and change im cloth. E go inside di house of di Lord and worship. Den e come im own house, and when e ask for food, dem put bread before am and e eat.
Den im servants talk to am say, “Wetin be dis wey you do? You fast and weep for di pikin while e dey alive, but when di pikin die, you rise up and eat bread.”
E talk say, “While di pikin still dey alive, I fast and weep, because I talk say, ‘Who know whether di Lord go show me grace, so that di pikin go live?’
But now e don die. Why I go fast? I fit bring am back again? I go go meet am, but e no go return to me.”
David comfort im wife Bathsheba, go in to am and sleep with am. E born pikin man, and David call im name Solomon. Di Lord love am,
and send word by di hand of Nathan di prophet, and e call im name Jedidiah, for di Lord sake.
Now Joab fight against Rabbah of di pikin dem of Ammon and take di royal city.
Joab send messengers to David and talk say, “I don fight against Rabbah. Yes, I don take di city of waters.
So now gather di rest of di people together, camp against di city and take am, so that I no go take di city and dem call am by my name.”
David gather all di people together, go Rabbah, fight against am and take am.
E take di crown of dem king from im head. Im weight na one talent of gold, and precious stones dey inside am, and dem put am on David head. E bring out di spoil of di city, plenty plenty.

E bring out di people wey dey inside am and put dem to work with saws, iron picks and iron axes, and make dem pass through di brick kiln. E do so to all di cities of di pikin dem of Ammon. Den David and all di people return to Jerusalem.
E happen say after dis, Absalom di pikin of David get one beautiful sister wey im name na Tamar, and Amnon di pikin of David love am.
Amnon trouble so tay e make imself sick because of im sister Tamar, because Tamar na virgin, and Amnon think say e hard to do anything to am.
But Amnon get one friend wey im name na Jonadab, di pikin of Shimeah, David brother, and Jonadab na very crafty man.
E talk to am say, “Pikin man of di king, why you dey so thin from day to day? You no go tell me?” Amnon talk to am say, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom sister.”

Jonadab talk to am say, “Lie down on your bed and pretend say you sick. When your papa come see you, talk to am say, ‘I dey beg you, make my sister Tamar come give me bread to eat, and prepare di food before my eyes, so that I go see am and eat am from im hand.’”
So Amnon lie down and pretend say e sick. When di king come see am, Amnon talk to di king say, “I dey beg you, make my sister Tamar come make two cakes before my eyes, so that I go eat from im hand.”
Den David send word go Tamar for house say, “Go now to your brother Amnon house and prepare food for am.”
So Tamar go to im brother Amnon house, and Amnon dey lie down. Tamar take dough, knead am, make cakes before im eyes and bake di cakes.
E take di pan and pour dem out before am, but Amnon refuse to eat. Amnon talk say, “Make everybody go out from me.” Everybody go out from am.
Amnon talk to Tamar say, “Bring di food enter di room, so that I go eat from your hand.” Tamar take di cakes wey e make and bring dem enter di room to im brother Amnon.
When Tamar bring dem near am to eat, Amnon hold am and talk to am say, “Come, sleep with me, my sister.”
E answer am, “No, my brother, no force me, because dem no suppose do dis kind thing for Israel. No do dis foolishness.
As for me, wia I go carry my shame? And as for you, you go be like one of di fools for Israel. So now, I dey beg you, speak to di king, because e no go refuse make I be yours.”
But e no gree listen to im voice, and because e strong pass am, e force am and sleep with am.
Den Amnon hate am with very great hatred, because di hatred wey e hate am pass di love wey e love am before. Amnon talk to am say, “Rise, go.”
E talk to am say, “No be so, because dis great wrong of sending me away worse pass di other one wey you do to me.” But e no gree listen to am.
Den e call im servant wey dey serve am and talk say, “Put dis woman out from me, and lock di door after am.”
Tamar wear one garment of different colours, because na dis kind robes di king pikin woman dem wey be virgins dey wear. Den im servant bring am out and lock di door after am.
Tamar put ashes on im head, tear di garment of different colours wey dey im body, put im hand on im head, and go im way, dey cry loud as e dey go.

Im brother Absalom talk to am say, “Amnon your brother don dey with you? But now keep quiet, my sister. Na your brother e be. No take dis thing to heart.” So Tamar stay desolate for im brother Absalom house.
But when King David hear all dis things, e dey very angry.
Absalom no speak good or bad to Amnon, because Absalom hate Amnon since e force im sister Tamar.
E happen say after two full years, Absalom get people wey dey shear sheep for Baal Hazor wey dey beside Ephraim, and Absalom invite all di king pikin man dem.
Absalom come to di king and talk say, “See now, your servant get people wey dey shear sheep. I dey beg you, make di king and im servants go with your servant.”
Di king talk to Absalom say, “No, my pikin man, make we no all go, so that we no go be burden to you.” Absalom press am, but e no gree go, but e bless am.
Den Absalom talk say, “If e no be so, I dey beg you, make my brother Amnon go with us.” Di king talk to am say, “Why e go go with you?”
But Absalom press am, and e let Amnon and all di king pikin man dem go with am.
Absalom command im servants say, “Mark now, when Amnon heart dey merry with wine, and when I tell una, ‘Strike Amnon,’ den kill am. No fear. I no command una? Be brave and be strong.”
Absalom servants do Amnon as Absalom command. Den all di king pikin man dem rise, and everybody climb im mule and run.
E happen say while dem dey for di way, di news come to David say, “Absalom don kill all di king pikin man dem, and nobody remain of dem.”
Den di king rise, tear im garments and lie down for di ground, and all im servants stand near with dem cloth tear.

Jonadab, di pikin of Shimeah, David brother, answer, “Make my oga no think say dem don kill all di young men, di king pikin man dem, because na only Amnon die. By Absalom appointment, dem don decide dis since di day wey e force im sister Tamar.
So now make my oga di king no take di thing to im heart to think say all di king pikin man dem don die, because na only Amnon die.”
But Absalom run. Di young man wey dey watch lift up im eyes and look, and look, plenty people dey come by di way behind am by di hillside.
Jonadab talk to di king say, “Look, di king pikin man dem don come. As your servant talk, na so e be.”
E happen say as soon as e finish to speak, look, di king pikin man dem come, raise dem voice and weep. Di king too and all im servants weep very bitterly.
But Absalom run go Talmai di pikin of Ammihud, king of Geshur. David mourn for im pikin man every day.
So Absalom run go Geshur and stay dere three years.
King David soul long to go out to Absalom, because e don comfort concerning Amnon since e don die.
Now Joab di pikin of Zeruiah know say di king heart dey toward Absalom.

Joab send go Tekoa and bring one wise woman from dere, and talk to am say, “I dey beg you, pretend say you dey mourn, wear mourning cloth, no anoint yourself with oil, but be like woman wey don mourn for long time for dead person.
Go in to di king and speak to am like dis.” So Joab put di words for im mouth.
When di woman of Tekoa speak to di king, e fall on im face to di ground, bow down and talk say, “Help, king!”
Di king talk to am say, “Wetin dey worry you?” E answer, “Truly I na widow, and my husband don die.
Your servant get two pikin man dem, and dem quarrel together for di field, and nobody dey to separate dem, but one strike di other and kill am.

Look, di whole family don rise against your servant, and dem talk say, ‘Deliver am wey strike im brother, so that we go kill am for di life of im brother wey e kill, and destroy di heir too.’ So dem go quench my coal wey remain, and dem no go leave name or remnant for my husband for di earth.”
Di king talk to di woman say, “Go your house, and I go give order concerning you.”
Di woman of Tekoa talk to di king say, “My oga di king, make di iniquity dey on me and on my papa house, and make di king and im throne dey guiltless.”
Di king talk say, “Anybody wey talk anything to you, bring am to me, and e no go touch you again.”

Den e talk say, “I dey beg you, make di king remember di Lord your God, so that di avenger of blood no go destroy again, so that dem no go destroy my pikin man.” E talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, no even one hair of your pikin man go fall to di earth.”
Den di woman talk say, “I dey beg you, make your servant speak one word to my oga di king.” E talk say, “Talk.”

Di woman talk say, “Why den you plan dis kind thing against di people of God? Because as di king dey speak dis word, e be like person wey dey guilty, since di king no bring im banished one come back home.
Because we must die, and we be like water wey spill for di ground wey nobody fit gather again. God no dey take away life, but e dey make plan so that di banished one no go be outcast from am.
So now, as I come speak dis word to my oga di king, na because di people don make me fear. Your servant talk say, ‘I go speak to di king now. Maybe di king go do wetin im servant ask.
Because di king go hear and deliver im servant from di hand of di man wey wan destroy me and my pikin man together from di inheritance of God.’
Den your servant talk say, ‘Make di word of my oga di king comfort me, because as angel of God, na so my oga di king be to discern good and bad. Make di Lord your God dey with you.’”
Den di king answer di woman, “I dey beg you, no hide anything from me wey I go ask you.” Di woman talk say, “Make my oga di king speak now.”

Di king talk say, “Joab hand dey with you for all dis?” Di woman answer, “As your soul dey alive, my oga di king, nobody fit turn to di right hand or to di left from anything wey my oga di king don speak, because na your servant Joab command me, and na im put all dis words for your servant mouth.
Na to change di face of di matter your servant Joab do dis thing. My oga wise according to di wisdom of di angel of God, to know all things wey dey di earth.”
Di king talk to Joab say, “Look now, you don do dis thing. Go, bring di young man Absalom back again.”

Joab fall on im face to di ground, bow down and thank di king. Joab talk say, “Today your servant know say I don find favour for your eyes, my oga di king, because di king don do wetin im servant ask.”
So Joab rise, go Geshur and bring Absalom come Jerusalem.
Di king talk say, “Make e go im own house, but make e no see my face.” So Absalom go im own house and e no see di king face.
Now for all Israel nobody dey wey dem praise pass Absalom for im beauty. From di sole of im foot reach di crown of im head, no blemish dey for am.
Every year end e dey cut di hair of im head, because e heavy on am. When e cut am, e weigh di hair of im head, 200 shekels by di king weight.
Dem born three pikin man dem and one pikin woman for Absalom wey im name na Tamar. Di woman na woman wey get beautiful face.
Absalom live two full years for Jerusalem, and e no see di king face.
Den Absalom send for Joab to send am to di king, but Joab no gree come to am. E send again di second time, but e no gree come.
So e talk to im servants say, “Look, Joab field near mine, and barley dey dere. Go set am on fire.” Absalom servants set di field on fire.
Den Joab rise, come to Absalom for im house, and talk to am say, “Why your servants set my field on fire?”

Absalom answer Joab, “Look, I send to you, talk say, ‘Come here, so that I go send you to di king, to talk say, “Why I come from Geshur? E go better for me to still dey dere.”’ So now make me see di king face, and if iniquity dey for me, make e kill me.”
So Joab come to di king and tell am, and when e call Absalom, Absalom come to di king, bow down on im face to di ground before di king, and di king kiss Absalom.
E happen say after dis, Absalom prepare chariots and horses for imself, and 50 men to run before am.

Absalom dey rise early and stand beside di way of di gate. When any man get case wey must come to di king for judgment, Absalom go call am and talk say, “Wia be your city?” E go talk say, “Your servant na from one of di tribes of Israel.”
Absalom talk to am say, “Look, your claims good and right, but di king no appoint anybody to hear you.”
Absalom talk again say, “Oh, if dem make me judge for di land, so that every man wey get any case or cause go come to me, and I go do am justice!”
E happen say when any man come near to bow down to am, e go stretch out im hand, hold am and kiss am.
Na so Absalom do to all Israel wey come to di king for judgment. So Absalom steal di hearts of di men of Israel.
E happen say after 40 years, Absalom talk to di king say, “I dey beg you, make I go pay my vow wey I vow to di Lord for Hebron.
Because your servant make vow while I dey live for Geshur for Syria, talk say, ‘If di Lord go truly bring me back to Jerusalem, den I go serve di Lord.’”
Di king talk to am say, “Go in peace.” So e rise and go Hebron.
But Absalom send spies go through all di tribes of Israel say, “As soon as una hear di sound of di trumpet, den una go talk say, ‘Absalom na king for Hebron.’”
200 men from Jerusalem go with Absalom, dem invite dem, and dem go in dem simplicity, and dem no know anything.
Absalom send for Ahithophel di Gilonite, David counsellor, from im city Giloh, while e dey offer di sacrifices. Di conspiracy strong, because di people dey increase always with Absalom.
One messenger come to David say, “Di hearts of di men of Israel dey follow Absalom.”

David talk to all im servants wey dey with am for Jerusalem say, “Rise, make we run, because if no be so, nobody among us go escape from Absalom. Hurry to go, so that e no go overtake us quick, bring evil down on us and strike di city with di edge of di sword.”
Di king servants talk to di king say, “Look, your servants ready to do whatever my oga di king choose.”
Di king go out, and all im household follow am. Di king leave ten concubines to keep di house.
Di king go out, and all di people follow am, and dem stop for Beth Merhak.
All im servants pass on beside am, and all di Cherethites, all di Pelethites and all di Gittites, 600 men wey follow am from Gath, pass on before di king.
Den di king talk to Ittai di Gittite say, “Why you dey go with us too? Return and stay with di king, because you na foreigner, and exile from your own place.
You come only yesterday, so I go make you waka up and down with us today, as I dey go wia I fit go? Return, and carry your brothers go back. Make mercy and truth dey with you.”

Ittai answer di king and talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, and as my oga di king dey alive, surely for any place wey my oga di king go dey, whether for death or for life, na dere your servant go dey too.”
David talk to Ittai say, “Go, cross over.” Ittai di Gittite cross over, with all im men and all di small pikin dem wey dey with am.
All di country weep with loud voice, and all di people cross over. Di king imself too cross di brook Kidron, and all di people cross over toward di way of di wilderness.
Look, Zadok too, and all di Levites with am, dey carry di ark of di covenant of God. Dem put down di ark of God, and Abiathar go up until all di people finish to pass out of di city.
Di king talk to Zadok say, “Carry di ark of God go back inside di city. If I find favour for di Lord eyes, e go bring me back and show me am and im dwelling place.
But if e talk say, ‘I no delight for you,’ look, I dey here, make e do to me wetin good for am.”
Di king talk to Zadok di priest too say, “You no be seer? Return inside di city in peace, with your two pikin man dem, Ahimaaz your pikin man and Jonathan di pikin of Abiathar.
Look, I go wait for di fords of di wilderness until word come from you to inform me.”
So Zadok and Abiathar carry di ark of God go back Jerusalem, and dem stay dere.

David go up by di ascent of di Mount of Olives, and e dey weep as e dey go up. Im head cover, and e go barefoot, and all di people wey dey with am cover everybody im head, and dem go up dey weep as dem dey go up.
Somebody tell David say, “Ahithophel dey among di conspirators with Absalom.” David talk say, “Di Lord, I dey beg you, turn Ahithophel counsel to foolishness.”
E happen say when David reach di top of di ascent wia dem dey worship God, look, Hushai di Archite come meet am with im coat tear and earth dey im head.
David talk to am say, “If you pass on with me, den you go be burden to me,
but if you return to di city and tell Absalom, ‘I go be your servant, king. As I be your papa servant before, na so I go be your servant now,’ den you fit defeat Ahithophel counsel for me.
Zadok and Abiathar di priests no dey with you dere? E go be say, any thing wey you hear from di king house, you go tell Zadok and Abiathar di priests.
Look, dem two pikin man dem dey dere with dem, Ahimaaz, Zadok pikin man, and Jonathan, Abiathar pikin man. By dem hand you go send to me everything wey you hear.”
So Hushai, David friend, enter di city, and Absalom enter Jerusalem.

When David don pass di top small, look, Ziba, Mephibosheth servant, meet am with two donkeys wey dem saddle, and 200 loaves of bread, 100 clusters of raisins, 100 summer fruits and one skin of wine for dem.

Di king talk to Ziba say, “Wetin be dis?” Ziba talk say, “Di donkeys na for di king household to ride, di bread and summer fruit na for di young men to eat, and di wine na so that di weak go drink for di wilderness.”
Di king talk say, “Wia your oga pikin man dey?” Ziba talk to di king say, “Look, e dey stay for Jerusalem, because e talk say, ‘Today di house of Israel go restore my papa kingdom to me.’”
Den di king talk to Ziba say, “Look, all wetin belong to Mephibosheth na your own.” Ziba talk say, “I bow down. Make I find favour for your eyes, my oga di king.”
When King David reach Bahurim, look, one man come out from dere from di family of di house of Saul wey im name na Shimei, di pikin of Gera. E come out, dey curse as e dey come.
E throw stones at David and at all King David servants, and all di people and all di mighty men dey for im right hand and for im left.
Shimei talk as e dey curse say, “Go, go, you man of blood, you wicked man!

Di Lord don return on you all di blood of di house of Saul, wey you reign for im place, and di Lord don deliver di kingdom into di hand of your pikin man Absalom. Look, dem don catch you for your own mischief, because you na man of blood.”
Den Abishai di pikin of Zeruiah talk to di king say, “Why dis dead dog go curse my oga di king? I dey beg you, make I go over and cut off im head.”
Di king talk say, “Wetin I get to do with una, Zeruiah pikin man dem? If e dey curse, and if di Lord don talk to am say, ‘Curse David,’ who go talk say, ‘Why you do so?’”

David talk to Abishai and to all im servants say, “Look, my pikin man wey come out of my body dey look for my life. E go worse pass dat for dis Benjamite now! Leave am alone, make e curse, because di Lord don tell am.
Maybe di Lord go look my affliction, and di Lord go repay me good for im cursing of me today.”
So David and im men go by di way, and Shimei waka along di hillside opposite am, dey curse as e dey go, throw stones at am and throw dust.
Di king and all di people wey dey with am reach tired, and dem refresh demselves dere.
Absalom and all di people, di men of Israel, come Jerusalem, and Ahithophel dey with am.
E happen say, when Hushai di Archite, David friend, come to Absalom, Hushai talk to Absalom say, “Make di king live long! Make di king live long!”
Absalom talk to Hushai say, “Na dis be your kindness to your friend? Why you no go with your friend?”
Hushai talk to Absalom say, “No, but di one wey di Lord, dis people and all di men of Israel don choose, na im I go be for, and with am I go stay.
Again, who I suppose serve? I no suppose serve before im pikin man? As I serve before your papa, na so I go dey before you.”
Den Absalom talk to Ahithophel say, “Give your counsel on wetin we go do.”
Ahithophel talk to Absalom say, “Go in to your papa concubines wey e leave to keep di house, and all Israel go hear say your papa hate you. Den all wey dey with you go strong.”
So dem pitch tent for Absalom on top of di house, and Absalom go in to im papa concubines before di eyes of all Israel.
Di counsel of Ahithophel wey e give for dem days be like say man ask for di oracle of God. Na so all Ahithophel counsel dey with David and with Absalom.
Moreover Ahithophel talk to Absalom say, “Make I choose 12,000 men now, and I go rise and chase David tonight.
I go come on am while e tired and im hands weak, and I go make am fear. All di people wey dey with am go run, and I go strike di king only,
and I go bring back all di people to you. Di man wey you dey look for na like say all return. So all di people go dey in peace.”
Di word please Absalom well and all di elders of Israel.
Den Absalom talk say, “Call Hushai di Archite now too, make we hear wetin e go talk.”
When Hushai come to Absalom, Absalom speak to am talk say, “Ahithophel don speak like dis. We go do wetin e talk? If no, you speak.”
Hushai talk to Absalom say, “Di counsel wey Ahithophel give dis time no good.”

Hushai talk again say, “You know your papa and im men, say dem na mighty men, and dem bitter for dem mind like bear wey dem rob im cubs for di field. Your papa na man of war, and e no go sleep with di people.
Look, e don hide inside one pit now, or for another place. E go happen say, when some of dem fall at di first, anybody wey hear am go talk say, ‘Slaughter dey among di people wey follow Absalom.’
Even di brave one wey im heart be like lion heart go melt completely, because all Israel know say your papa na mighty man, and dem wey dey with am na brave men.
But I counsel say make all Israel gather to you, from Dan reach Beersheba, plenty like sand wey dey by di sea, and make you go to battle in your own person.
So we go come on am for any place wia dem go find am, and we go fall on am like dew dey fall on di ground, and from am and from all di men wey dey with am, we no go leave even one.
Moreover, if e don enter city, den all Israel go bring ropes to dat city, and we go pull am enter di river until even one small stone no go dey dere.”

Absalom and all di men of Israel talk say, “Di counsel of Hushai di Archite better pass di counsel of Ahithophel.” Because di Lord don decide to defeat di good counsel of Ahithophel, so that di Lord go bring evil on Absalom.
Den Hushai talk to Zadok and to Abiathar di priests say, “Ahithophel counsel Absalom and di elders of Israel like dis and like dis, and I counsel like dis and like dis.
So now send quick tell David say, ‘No stay dis night for di fords of di wilderness, but cross over by all means, so that dem no go swallow di king and all di people wey dey with am.’”
Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz dey stay by En Rogel, and one maid dey go tell dem, and dem go tell King David, because dem no suppose let people see dem enter di city.
But one boy see dem and tell Absalom. Dem two go away quick and come to di house of one man for Bahurim wey get well for im compound, and dem go down inside am.
Di man wife take cover spread am over di well mouth, and spread grain on top, so nobody know anything.

Absalom servants come to di woman for di house and talk say, “Wia Ahimaaz and Jonathan dey?” Di woman talk to dem say, “Dem don cross di brook of water.” When dem look and no find dem, dem return to Jerusalem.
E happen say after dem don go, dem come up out of di well, go tell King David, and talk to David say, “Rise, cross di water quick, because na so Ahithophel counsel against you.”
Den David rise with all di people wey dey with am, and dem cross di Jordan. By morning light nobody remain wey no cross di Jordan.
When Ahithophel see say dem no follow im counsel, e saddle im donkey, rise, go home to im house for im city, put im household in order, hang imself, and e die. Dem bury am for im papa tomb.
Den David reach Mahanaim. Absalom cross di Jordan, im and all di men of Israel wey dey with am.
Absalom put Amasa over di army for Joab place. Amasa na pikin of one man wey im name na Ithra di Israelite, wey go in to Abigal di pikin woman of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab mama.
Israel and Absalom camp for di land of Gilead.
E happen say, when David reach Mahanaim, Shobi di pikin of Nahash from Rabbah of di pikin dem of Ammon, and Machir di pikin of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai di Gileadite from Rogelim,
bring beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils, roasted seeds,
honey, butter, sheep and cheese from di herd for David and for di people wey dey with am to eat, because dem talk say, “Di people dey hungry, tired and thirsty for di wilderness.”
